title: Totem of Screaming Black Man
description: A texture pack that turns your normal totem of undying into a screaming black man.
body:
## Totem of Screaming Black Man
**What does this resource pack add?** 
Well, it changes the texture of your normal Totem of Undying into a screaming black man. In other words, your totem will now express itself more emotionally when it pops. I know, its pretty useless. But it is a cursed pvp pack, so yeah.

**Future improvements that will be added to the pack:**
The totem will be smaller, so that if you DO use this pack seriously, the screaming totem won't cover your while screen.
Also, I will greyscale the popping particles to match the image of the totem.

_Made by itsMrHello_
